role: Historical exploratory knowledge audit, not a prospective validation or universally optimal controls.

audit_summary.scope: Historical local artifacts only; no checkpoint loads, GPU work, model calls, reruns, or new target-label evaluations.
limits: Archive-conditioned adaptive experiment selection; no population success rates.
Distinct global IDs are not proof of statistical independence; neighboring geography and shared source remain.
No checkpoint byte/RNG/runtime equality verified by these comparison JSON files.
Single changed recorded control does not rule out unrecorded confounding.
Unlabeled area, consistency and source F1 do not establish target-quality effects.
Missing historical request restricts transfer even if within-artifact checks pass.

frozen_192_action_specific_quality.scope: Descriptive action-specific reanalysis of existing frozen C_expert D1 versus A_fixed D2, E10 only. No new labels, training, threshold fits or scientific calls.
frozen_192_action_specific_quality.action: D_steps_per_G_step: 2 -> 1; other five initial scalars unchanged in frozen census
limitations: Agent-selected D1 subset is not randomly assigned across tiles.
The 30 cells are nested within 8 geographic tiles, not 30 independent replications.
Positive and adverse responses can coexist within a tile.
Original E10 full-cohort result and uncertainty are unchanged.
These now-published contexts/outcomes are historical knowledge, not unseen future evaluation cases.

manifest_note: Only source identities, configurations and derived numerical measurements are published; no raw private logs, labels or checkpoints.
reading_guidance: Read historical-intervention-cases.md for decisions. Load this evidence index only to verify a scoped numerical claim; do not preload it for every training review.
